purpose: Preregistered out-of-window test of price affine invariance at a distinct measured C value

transformations.expected_price: O,C mapped to 70000-price; H,L mapped to 70000-L,70000-H

acceptance: Capture each listed export after this registration. Require the formula to remain visible in the symbol field; common timestamps; full inclusive 26-bar window and 540 post-END bars; exact OHLC transform and unchanged Volume on the measured range; repeated exports consistent; all six Lite lanes affine-equivariant within 1e-8 with identical visibility; each lane independently fits locked C within 1e-6 and RMSE below 1e-8; recurrence reconstruction error below 1e-8 with zero visibility mismatches. The return export must match the native baseline. Report failed or incompatible transformations without scoring their C prediction.
locked_model_implication: For Y'_t=aY_t+b and P'_t=aP_t+b, EMA alpha=(Y'_t-Y'_{t-1})/(P'_t-Y'_{t-1}) equals the native alpha; therefore C remains invariant. This tests that implication outside the prior C=50 window, not the unknown OHLCV-to-C law itself.
limits: The three transforms share one market episode and one C=62 window. Passing supports price-affine invariance of the fitted EMA coefficient in this case, but does not establish volume independence, identify C=f(OHLCV,Delta), or generalize across sessions/timeframes. Existing C=62 exports are reference measurements only; only post-registration named exports are scored.
